en: Sepia-toned postcard showing two male actors in theatrical costume posed against a plain studio background. The shorter man on the left, in an ornate military-style uniform with a feathered hat and sash, glares upward at the taller man on the right, who wears a formal tailcoat and monocle while looking down disdainfully. Decorative German text titles the scene at the top, and the actors' names are printed beneath each figure. A photographer/publisher credit and the date 1913 appear at the lower right.
